integrity.visual_evidence: The Subsurface window shows the 'SampleDivesV2.ssrf' data before the save operation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires saving to a 'Local Git repository' named 'dives.git' in '~/Documents/SubsurfaceBackup/'. Note: Subsurface's UI may not explicitly show a 'Local Git repository' option in the file filter dropdown (it often only shows 'Subsurface files'). The agent is successful if it creates the directory and saves the file with the exact name 'dives.git' via the GUI, even if the underlying save format defaults to XML due to software limitations.
